title: iNova Pharmaceuticals (Australia) Pty Ltd - Juno PC Holdings Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced informal review under the Informal Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Former provisional date for announcement of findings (31 October) delayed to allow iNova more time to provide additional information.
ACCC received further information from iNova.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.
ACCC discontinued its public review after iNova informed of its intention to withdraw its proposed acquisition of Juno PC.

body_sections.Summary: iNova Pharmaceuticals (Australia) Pty Ltd proposed to acquire Juno PC Holdings Pty Ltd.
